feedTitle: Isle of Man 5 day weather forecast

items.title: 5 day forecast updated as of 15 November 2026 11:30am
items.description:
##Today##

Rain will continue at first, possibly heavy for a time, before clearing to isolated showers through the afternoon. The light to moderate southwest wind will veer northwest and strengthen as the last of the rain clears through. Maximum temperature 10°C.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 3°C and max. air temperature 10°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

10-15


##Wind Speed##

22


##Wind Direction##

NW


##Wind##

South 15-20, veering northwest 20-30 in the afternoon and evening, with gusts of 40.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain. Occasional hill fog.


##Comments##

Strong winds later. Heavy rain late morning/ early afternoon.


##Tomorrow##

Clear intervals and the risk of isolated showers overnight into Monday, with a small risk of these showers turning wintry over higher ground. Minimum temperature of -1°C on higher ground and in the central valley, which will bring a risk of frost and ice. Mainly dry with bright or sunny spells during the daytime, then cloud thickens through the evening with a band of rain arriving around midnight. Fresh to strong northwest winds become light and variable for a time during the day, before becoming easterly in the afternoon, then increasing strong to gale force later. Top temperature of 8°C.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature -1°C and max. air temperature 8°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

1-4


##Wind Speed##

14


##Wind Direction##

NW


##Wind##

Northwest 15-20, decreasing west 5-10 by midday, then sharply becoming east or southeast in the afternoon. Gradually increasing to 25-35, with gusts of 45, later.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate in rain or showers.


##Comments##

Risk of frost and ice at first. Strong winds and gales later.


##Tuesday, 17 November 2026##

Rain continuing through the night into Tuesday, turning heavy at times, and initially wintry on higher ground before temperatures rise. Minimum temperature 1°C . The persistent band of rain clears in the morning, though intermittent spells of rain continue for much of the day. Strong to gale force east winds gradually easing. Top temperature 10°C.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 1°C and max. air temperature 10°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

12-20


##Wind Speed##

25


##Wind Direction##

E


##Wind##

East 25-35, with gusts of 45-50 at first, decreasing west 20-30 through the morning, then decreasing 5-15 later.


##Visibility##

Moderate or good, occasionally poor. Occasional hill fog.


##Comments##

Strong to gale force winds at first. Risk of snow accumulations on hills at first, impacts on low ground unlikely. Heavy rain.


##Wednesday, 18 November 2026##

Often cloudy with occasional rain or showers for much of this period. Moderate to fresh northeast winds decreasing to become light to moderate. Top temperature 9°C.
